title: Deep Learning Engineer
summary: Design, train and scale neural networks, and know what happens underneath the framework. Start after Foundations.

stages.title: Deep Learning
stages.passCriteria: You can train an image or text model in PyTorch, explain each step, and explain how attention works.

stages.title: Deep Learning in Depth
stages.passCriteria: You can derive and implement optimization, regularization and normalization for deep networks.

stages.title: Architectures
stages.passCriteria: You can explain and implement CNNs and Transformers, and say when to use each.

stages.title: Training & Efficiency
stages.passCriteria: You can explain mixed precision, data and model parallelism, and quantization, and when each one helps.

stages.title: Generative Models
stages.passCriteria: You can explain how a diffusion model turns noise into an image, and implement one.

stages.title: Portfolio Project
stages.passCriteria: You can take one model from raw data to a deployed, tested service, show where it fails, and explain your trade-offs.

stages.title: Interview Prep
stages.passCriteria: You can solve timed coding problems on data structures and algorithms, and answer ML knowledge and system design questions under time pressure.
